title.zh: v2.0.34 钢琴卷帘滑音试听与交互质感飞跃：琴键上下滑动试听（Glissando）、网格悬浮幽灵音符光标预警、Alt+滚轮即时微调力度、拖拽音长浮动HUD与首小节一键复刻（Dup B1）
title.en: v2.0.34 Piano Roll Keybed Glissando, Interactive Hover Cursors & Rhythmic Polish: Keybed drag-auditioning (glissando), ghost hover previews, Alt+wheel velocity nudging, floating note resize HUD, and 1-click Bar 1 duplication (Dup B1)

highlights.zh: **琴键上下滑动连续试听（Keybed Glissando / Drag-Auditioning）**：钢琴卷帘左侧象牙与黑曜石 3D 琴键槽全新支持连续滑音试听。按住鼠标或触控拖拽在键盘上快速上下掠过时，滑过的每个琴键均实时击发声学校准音符并点亮金黄热力图高光反馈，松开平滑归位，音域定位与和弦声部感知如行云流水。
highlights.en: **Piano Keybed Glissando & Drag-Auditioning**: Sweeping up and down the 3D ivory and obsidian pitch gutter keys with pointer down now triggers smooth acoustic glissando auditioning. Each key struck illuminates with a responsive golden heatmap glow and releases cleanly, providing effortless tactile pitch inspection.

highlights.zh: **网格鼠标悬浮幽灵音符与工具预警光标（Interactive Hover Ghost Cursor & Tool Targeting）**：铅笔工具模式下，指针移至网格任意空白位置自动投射半透明虚线幽灵预警音符（带微发光与音名/和弦印章角标），所见即所得；橡皮模式下悬浮目标音符显现实时红色脉冲警戒高光，剪刀模式下提供切割线预览，彻底消除盲目操作。
highlights.en: **Interactive Ghost Hover Cursor & Tool Targeting**: In pencil mode, hovering over any empty cell displays a translucent dashed ghost note preview showing the exact pitch name (or chord stamp name) and duration before clicking. The eraser mode highlights targeted notes with a pulsing red warning glow, and scissors mode renders precise split guides.

highlights.zh: **Alt + 滚轮即时微调音符力度（Alt + Mouse Wheel Velocity Nudge）**：鼠标悬停在任意音符上（或选中多音符）后，按住 Alt 键上下滚动滚轮即可直接以 ±5 步进微调音符力度，实时更新音符发光热力图并伴随微切片声学试听，界面顶部同步浮现数值 HUD 提示（如 Velocity: 105），指尖操作畅快淋漓。
highlights.en: **Alt + Mouse Wheel Velocity Nudge**: Hovering over any note or selecting multiple notes and scrolling with the Alt key instantly nudges velocity up or down by ±5. Dynamic heatmap colors update immediately, triggering acoustic velocity auditioning with a sleek HUD toast confirming the new value.
